semantic_evaluation.evaluator: Codex assistant followup_dev_review; independent semantic review, not a human grading claim
semantic_evaluation.method: Fresh offline reading of all 22 unedited answers, actual prompts/contexts/citation maps and frozen six-question key. No evaluator model calls. Distinct factual propositions are counted once; repeated wording and examples modifying the same proposition do not add denominator units. Independent document-topic assertions count; epistemic inability statements and clarification requests do not. Partial support does not credit a whole proposition. Full-corpus correctness is distinct from actual-context faithfulness. A context faithfulness is N/A. Grounding requires support for every factual claim in actually cited chunks. Citation syntax is scored separately from attribution and semantic completeness. Q4 needs clarification; Q5/Q6 require semantic refusal, with exact string assessed separately. After fresh review, identical prior-run answer/context pairs were checked for consistent valid claim granularity; no scoring definition or denominator was relaxed. Raw/final coverage is independently recomputed from frozen source offsets. Automated validation checks structure and quote membership, not semantic correctness.

limitations: Semantic judgments were authored by the identified evaluator, not independently proven by this verifier.
A correct supported cited C answer is the reviewed plan's completion criterion, not an explicit assignment minimum.
PNG hashes establish retained files; genuine capture provenance/readability is documented in the capture manifest and reviewed separately.
